TRANSPARENT ANALYSIS

Know what the numbers can tell you.

This is a descriptive analysis of the supplied restaurant listing snapshot. The file has no collection date, transactions, revenue or time series. The dashboard measures the restaurants represented in the file; it does not estimate current market share or sales.

Metric definitions

Restaurants
Distinct Restaurant IDs after validating uniqueness. Each ID is one restaurant listing.
Average rating
Simple mean of ratings greater than zero. A zero rating becomes null (unrated). Votes are displayed separately; vote weighting is not used.
Median cost for two
Median of positive source costs within one market. Suppressed across markets and for the Philippines, where the source says “Botswana Pula(P)”. No exchange-rate conversion or guessed currency correction is applied.
Delivery and booking availability
Share of the currently filtered restaurants with the corresponding source flag set to Yes. These describe listed services, not orders or utilization.
Cuisine counts
Comma-separated cuisines are split, trimmed and deduplicated within each restaurant. A restaurant may appear under several cuisines, so these counts are not additive.
Price tier
Source values 1–4, labeled Budget, Mid-range, Premium and Luxury for readability. These are relative categories, not globally equivalent currency bands.

Data handling and limits

  • The raw file is preserved. The processed table retains damaged text rather than guessing restaurant names.
  • Zero or negative costs are treated as unavailable, never free meals. Missing cuisines remain missing.
  • Country names use an explicit project lookup for this dataset's country codes, which are not ISO numeric codes.
  • The scatterplot aggregates restaurants into price/rating cells; marker size shows the number of listings in a cell. It uses all eligible filtered records.
  • Ratings, votes and availability are observational. Their associations do not prove causation, demand or profitability.
  • Geographic coverage is uneven. National or global conclusions require a representative sample.

Source: user-supplied Zomato Restaurant Dataset.csv. Independent portfolio analysis; not affiliated with Zomato. Original dataset provenance, collection date and redistribution license were not supplied.
